query: What performance score is required for a candidate to satisfy the Foodborne Illness Risk Factors and Food Code Interventions performance area during FDA standardization?
expected_answer: The candidate must have an average score of at least 90 percent and must not disagree with the FDA Standard on more than 12 items in any one establishment.
